0022600183.text: The Phoenix Suns (1-4), who have lost three straight and sit 3.5 games back in 3rd in the Pacific and 12th in the West, host the Portland Trail Blazers (5-1), who lead the Northwest, are 4-0 on the road, and have won two straight. Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain), while Portland is without Ja Morant (hamstring) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee, surgery). The teams have met once in 2026-27, with Portland winning 124-83 in Portland on October 21, and the Suns won the 2025-26 season series 2-1.
